data.statement: Audio Assembly final whole-book WAV can inherit Scene Ambience stereo 44.1 kHz parameters from the first playable block, inflating output and hitting the classic WAV RIFF size limit. Make final assembly choose explicit output audio parameters, preferably mono 24 kHz PCM or first speech block parameters, so leading Scene Ambience does not upsample the full audiobook.

acceptance: A whole-book assembly with leading Scene Ambience and later mono 24 kHz speech writes a mono 24 kHz final audiobook while still including the mixed ambience, and existing Audio Assembly tests remain green.
assumptions: Use first non-Scene-Ambience speech/source WAV parameters as the final output reference when present; retain fallback behavior for pause-only or speechless edge cases.
data.reason: The user explicitly approved continuing without confirmation, and the scope is a focused Audio Assembly service fix with automated tests.
scope: In scope: Audio Assembly final composition parameter selection, focused tests proving Scene Ambience leading blocks do not force stereo 44.1 kHz output, requirement traceability, and Audio Assembly component documentation. Out of scope: adding RF64/W64/FLAC/MP3 support, changing the Audio Assembly UI, changing Scene Mix preview output parameters, or deleting/resetting the external DuneMessiah runtime artifacts.
data.understanding: Audio Assembly currently derives final WAV output parameters from the first playable block. When Scene Ambience is included and appears before speech, the final whole-book output can inherit stereo 44.1 kHz ambience parameters, causing speech to be upsampled and inflating the generated WAV enough to hit the classic RIFF size limit. This fix will make final assembly select explicit speech-preferred output parameters so ambience can still be mixed but cannot upsample the whole audiobook merely by being first.

data.summary: Focused Audio Assembly regression fails before implementation: leading Scene Ambience causes final WAV nchannels=2 instead of expected mono speech params.
Focused Audio Assembly regression passes after implementation: leading Scene Ambience no longer forces stereo output params.
Audio Assembly service regression suite remains green after output parameter fix.

data.rationale: Keeps whole-book output size stable when ambience beds precede speech and prevents unnecessary upsampling toward the classic WAV RIFF size limit.
data.requirement: Audio Assembly final composition shall choose output WAV parameters from the first non-Scene-Ambience source WAV when one exists, so leading Scene Ambience cannot force the final audiobook into stereo 44.1 kHz output.
data.verification: Automated pytest focused regression plus full Audio Assembly service test file.
